reason: Verified: AdminDeployManager.java:527 executes 'boolean saved = gate.write(arenasConfig);' and the GameManager push at :530-534 runs unconditionally afterwards - there is no 'if (saved)' guard and no rollback, with lastSaveFailed (:541) as the only record, so a failed write does leave the live arena using spawn/mob-spawn/core values that are not on disk. One half of the finding's trigger is wrong, however: the read-only case can never reach :530, because :457-462 returns before the write when the gate is unwritable and :471-478 returns again if the re-read is unusable or the gate is read-only; only an IOException out of YamlFiles.write (:111-131, whose ATOMIC_MOVE leaves the target file unchanged) can produce saved=false with the push still executed. The ordering also contradicts the codebase's own stated discipline in the sibling path at :781-786 ('push only after saveSpawnPoints() succeeds ... pushing on failure is more misleading'), so this reads as an oversight rather than by design. Impact stays low rather than medium: the command path tells the admin the change 'only lives in memory and will be lost on restart' (messages.yml:208), '/hilltop deploy reloadnodes' (:1090 -> loadSpawnPoints) restores memory from disk, and the next successful save rewrites this arena's spawn/core keys from savedSpawnPoints (:471-517), so the disk/memory divergence converges on the in-memory state instead of persisting - the residual harm is a live arena using coordinates that exist only in RAM until then, plus a hand-edit of arenas.yml made after the failure being overwritten by that next save.

AdminDeployManager.java:457-462  YamlFileGate gate = arenasGate(); if (gate == null || !gate.writable()) { lastSaveFailed = true; return false; }   <- read-only never reaches the push at :530
AdminDeployManager.java:781-786  // 先写盘再推送：写盘失败时内存里的实例已经改了反而更误导（重启后回旧值），// 因此推送只在 saveSpawnPoints() 成功后才做  boolean saved = saveSpawnPoints(); if (saved) { pushWaitingLocationToLiveInstance(); }   <- project's own rule, contradicted by :527-534
AdminDeployManager.java:471-479  YamlFiles.Loaded loaded = gate.load(); ... arenasConfig = loaded.config();   <- next successful save re-serialises savedSpawnPoints, so the divergence is self-healing
